title: The long form is the master; shorts are selections
text: FB = the same hook + a digest of the whole YT in its order, ending on the hardest line; 1-min = the same hook + one beat. Narrowed: the FB groups one place's material together. Weakened: compilations have no YT long form (the FB D1 is the master).

source.heading: Candidates from the overnight study (2026-11-23, none confirmed)

confirm: Is every short piece taken from the long form, in its order?
